intro: Albania was Europe's poorest country in 1991; it has grown since, with tourism booming.

chapters.title: Tourism and power
text: Tourism has boomed as visitors discover the coast and mountains. Almost all of Albania's electricity comes from hydropower, and farming, especially olives, is important.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Many young Albanians emigrate for work, and money they send home is a big part of the economy.
